after_phase_0b._note: Measured 2026-06-04 on the shared sandbox box, which was NOT fully idle (a parallel agent ran intermittently); vitest especially is contention-sensitive, so treat these as indicative, not a clean idle-box anchor. CAVEATS: (1) tsc_noemit_seconds (~0.77s) is BOGUS — the harness runs bare `tsc --noEmit`, which resolves the solution-style root tsconfig (files:[] + project references) and typechecks nothing; the real gate `npm run typecheck` (tsconfig.app.json) is ~40s cold. (2) vitest_full_suite_seconds (~581s here; a direct clean re-run measured ~726s, so the honest range is ~580-730s) covers 89 files / 575 tests, of which only ~27s is actual test logic — the rest is per-file jsdom-environment + cold-import overhead under isolate:true. (3) vite_build (~42s) and playwright (~41s warm) are comparatively clean. Full analysis: docs/audits/2026-06-03-frontend-test-infra-speedup-analysis.md.
